turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy from your residence in Delhi?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Ananya from the State Bank security team. I am calling to confirm if you made a payment of nine thousand five hundred rupees this morning?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, yes, I did. I sent it to my grandson for his books. Is there a problem?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, the transaction went through perfectly. We are just doing a routine check for high-value transfers to ensure your account is safe.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. I was worried something happened to the money.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Everything is fine, Mr. Reddy. However, please remember that our bank will never call you to ask for your OTP or your secret PIN.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But why would they ask for that if they are from the bank?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Because scammers pretend to be us to steal your money. If anyone asks for your card number or Aadhaar details over the phone, just hang up immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will be careful. Thank you for telling me this, beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are welcome. Just stay alert and never share your passwords with anyone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Have a good day.
